MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我叫 wǒ jiào mean when it comes before a name? (1 mark)
   A. I am going to
   B. Where is
   C. I like
   D. My name is

2. What does 我 (wǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Teacher
   C. I, me
   D. Hello

3. Which final is written with two dots on top? (1 mark)
   A. e
   B. u
   C. o
   D. ü

4. Read the pinyin: nà shì wǒ gēge. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. This is my father.
   C. There are five people in my family.
   D. That is my older brother.

5. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ māma. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. There are five people in my family.
   D. That is my older brother.

6. What does 卧室 (wòshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. Bedroom
   C. In front of
   D. On

7. Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 在
   C. 有
   D. 上

8. What does 椅子 (yǐzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. House
   C. Left side
   D. In front of

9. Which Chinese word means "to sing"? (1 mark)
   A. 盘子 pánzi
   B. 快乐 kuàilè
   C. 唱歌 chànggē
   D. 礼物 lǐwù

10. Which verb goes with 茶? (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 去
   C. 是
   D. 喝

11. Fill the blank: 我____米饭。 (I eat rice.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 听
   C. 吃
   D. 喝

12. What does the broken telephone game teach? (1 mark)
   A. Careful listening
   B. Drawing
   C. Counting
   D. Fast running

13. What does 风很大 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain is heavy
   B. The cloud is light
   C. The sun is small
   D. The wind is very strong

14. What does 沙发在门旁边 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is in the garden
   B. The sofa is beside the door
   C. The door is in the sofa
   D. The sofa is under the door

15. What should you do first when you get a spoken instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to the whole instruction
   B. Act at once
   C. Guess
   D. Walk away

16. Fill the blank: ____好! (Hello, teacher!) (1 mark)
   A. 同学
   B. 朋友
   C. 老师
   D. 爸爸

17. Read the pinyin: lǎoshī hǎo! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye!
   B. My name is Xiaoming.
   C. Hello, teacher!
   D. And you?

18. What does 姐姐 (jiějie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Older sister
   C. To have, there is
   D. Mother

19. Which Chinese word means "love"? (1 mark)
   A. 爱 ài
   B. 谁 shéi
   C. 有 yǒu
   D. 姐姐 jiějie

20. What does 厨房 (chúfáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. On
   C. Kitchen
   D. Television

21. Which sentence means "There is a television in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 客厅里有电视。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

22. Which sentence means "The television is on the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在客厅。
   B. 电视在桌子上。
   C. 椅子在桌子下。
   D. 客厅里有电视。

23. What does 星期五,去清真寺 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, go to church
   B. On Friday, go to the mosque
   C. On Monday, go to school
   D. On Friday, rest at home

24. How can you stay safe with a digital reading journal? (1 mark)
   A. Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   B. Share it with strangers
   C. Use it without asking
   D. Post your address online

25. What clue tells you that 咖啡 is a drink in 我喝咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. The word 我
   B. The full stop
   C. The verb 吃
   D. The verb 喝

26. What does 牛奶 (niúnǎi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Meat
   C. Spinach
   D. Milk

27. Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 蔬菜
   B. 香蕉
   C. 晚饭
   D. 咖啡

28. Why does repetition help your reading? (1 mark)
   A. It builds smooth, fluent reading
   B. It makes the text shorter
   C. It removes tones
   D. It erases the words

29. What does 风来了 fēng lái le mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is big
   B. The rain has come
   C. The wind has come
   D. The snow is white

30. What does 花园 (huāyuán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Beside
   C. Living room
   D. Sofa

31. Which Chinese word means "bed"? (1 mark)
   A. 床 chuáng
   B. 放 fàng
   C. 下面 xiàmiàn
   D. 椅子 yǐzi

32. Which sentence means "Tomorrow is Thursday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 今天星期三。
   C. 我星期三去学校。
   D. 明天是星期四。

33. What does 星期四 (xīngqīsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. To go
   C. Thursday
   D. Seven

34. How many strokes does 三 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 2
   C. 4
   D. 3

35. What does 饼干 (bǐnggān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Cooked rice
   C. Lunch
   D. Biscuits

36. What does 牙 (yá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. To look, to see
   C. To touch
   D. Tooth

37. What is the last stroke written in 头? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 捺 nà
   D. 横 héng

38. How many strokes does 雨 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 11
   D. 6

39. Which sentence means "Today it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 今天雨下。
   B. 下今天雨。
   C. 雨下今天。
   D. 今天下雨。

40. What should you do if you make a mistake while presenting? (1 mark)
   A. Blame a friend
   B. Stop and cry
   C. Run away
   D. Stay calm, breathe and say it again

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我. (3 marks)

42. How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example. (2 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift." (3 marks)

44. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng. (2 marks)

45. Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin. (4 marks)

46. Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone. (3 marks)

47. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室. (2 marks)

48. Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。 (3 marks)

49. Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

50. Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有. (5 marks)

51. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school." (4 marks)

52. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. (2 marks)

53. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?" (4 marks)

54. Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝. (2 marks)

55. Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them. (4 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (3 marks)

57. Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday. (3 marks)

58. Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。 (3 marks)

59. Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — My name is
   叫 means to be called, so 我叫 introduces your name.

2. C — I, me
   我 (wǒ) means I, me.

3. D — ü
   The lips-rounded sound ee is written ü, with two dots.

4. D — That is my older brother.
   nà shì wǒ gēge. is 那是我哥哥。, which means "That is my older brother.".

5. B — This is my mother.
   zhè shì wǒ māma. is 这是我妈妈。, which means "This is my mother.".

6. B — Bedroom
   卧室 (wòshì) means bedroom.

7. B — 在
   在 means is at or is in.

8. A — Chair
   椅子 (yǐzi) means chair.

9. C — 唱歌 chànggē
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

10. D — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

11. C — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

12. A — Careful listening
   A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

13. D — The wind is very strong
   风 is wind and 很大 is very big or strong.

14. B — The sofa is beside the door
   旁边 is beside.

15. A — Listen to the whole instruction
   You need the whole message to follow it correctly.

16. C — 老师
   老师 is teacher.

17. C — Hello, teacher!
   lǎoshī hǎo! is 老师好!, which means "Hello, teacher!".

18. B — Older sister
   姐姐 (jiějie) means older sister.

19. A — 爱 ài
   爱 (ài) means love.

20. C — Kitchen
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

21. C — 客厅里有电视。
   客厅里有电视。 (kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.) means "There is a television in the living room.".

22. B — 电视在桌子上。
   电视在桌子上。 (diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.) means "The television is on the table.".

23. B — On Friday, go to the mosque
   清真寺 is a mosque.

24. A — Ask an adult first and share only with your teacher and class
   Keep personal information private.

25. D — The verb 喝
   喝 means to drink.

26. D — Milk
   牛奶 (niúnǎi) means milk.

27. C — 晚饭
   晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

28. A — It builds smooth, fluent reading
   Repeated reading builds fluency.

29. C — The wind has come
   风 is wind and 来了 is has come.

30. A — Garden
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

31. A — 床 chuáng
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

32. D — 明天是星期四。
   明天是星期四。 (míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.) means "Tomorrow is Thursday.".

33. C — Thursday
   星期四 (xīngqīsì) means Thursday.

34. D — 3
   三 is three horizontal lines.

35. D — Biscuits
   饼干 (bǐnggān) means biscuits.

36. D — Tooth
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

37. C — 捺 nà
   The order is 点, 点, 横, 撇, 捺.

38. B — 8
   雨 has eight strokes.

39. D — 今天下雨。
   今天 + 下雨.

40. D — Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   Everyone makes mistakes.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is above the sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b, 1 mark for p, 1 mark for another pair, 1 mark for the paper test or description.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.
